scripts.codegen: orval --config ./orval.config.ts && printf 'export * from "./generated/api";\n' > ../api-zod/src/index.ts && pnpm -w run typecheck:libs
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm run codegen && (git -C ../.. diff --exit-code HEAD -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/index.ts || { echo 'Generated API files are stale; run codegen and commit the generated output.' >&2; exit 1; }) && (test -z "$(git -C ../.. ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated)" || { echo 'New generated API files are not committed.' >&2; exit 1; })
